title: Gwinnett couple warn others after losing $800K in cryptocurrency scam

reading.body:
A retired couple lost approximately $800,000 to a cryptocurrency fraud scheme that used an AI-generated website to show false investment account balances. The scammer initiated contact via WhatsApp and exploited a common trust-building tactic, allowing the victim to withdraw smaller amounts initially before requesting a much larger withdrawal that revealed the scheme. The false display of funds on the AI-generated website kept the victim believing his money was available until the attempted large withdrawal exposed the fraud.

This failure occurred in the investment screening phase that should precede money transfer. The couple was not informed by the platform or their financial institution that they were viewing AI-generated content rather than authentic account information, and no human verification separated them from the false display. What would have caught this is a requirement that the couple verify their investment through their financial institution directly, or a warning system flagging transfers to unfamiliar cryptocurrency addresses.

Whether the AI-generated website was created specifically to deceive, or whether the scammers simply repurposed legitimate AI image generation tools for fraud, is not established by the reporting.

reports.title: Georgia couple loses $800K in sophisticated cryptocurrency scam
Gwinnett couple warn others after losing $800K in cryptocurrency scam

summary:
A retired Georgia couple lost nearly $800,000 in a cryptocurrency scam that started with a WhatsApp message from a stranger. The scammer convinced Jerry Dunaway to invest using a mobile trading app, beginning with small amounts and gradually increasing. Jerry was able to withdraw funds initially, which built his trust in the scheme. However, when he attempted a larger withdrawal, the money was unavailable, and police discovered the scammers had created a fake AI-generated website that showed false investment balances on his screen.

Jerry and Mindy Dunaway are now speaking publicly to warn others about the sophisticated tactics used by scammers. They describe feeling angry, embarrassed, and financially devastated after losing their entire life savings. The couple is working with Gwinnett County police, though investigators indicate that victims in these cases rarely recover their funds. Their children have started a GoFundMe campaign to help them cover daily expenses as they work to move forward.
